blocks.html: HERE’S THE MALL SCHEDULE OF ROBINSONS MALLS FOR CHRISTMAS AND NEW YEAR

Ready to shop for the Yuletide Season? Robinsons Malls has released its official mall hours and schedules for you to buy Christmas presents. Be guided by the following operating hours of various Robinsons malls in Luzon:

For those who haven’t finished their Christmas shopping, fear not as there is a Robinsons Mall you can always go to. As the operating hours is extended until 12:00 midnight, make sure to shop at Robinsons Galleria on December 1, 7, 8, 14, 15, 21, 22, 28 and 29; at Robinsons Place Las Piñas on December 29 and 30; at Robinsons Magnolia, Robinsons Place Manila and Robinsons Metro East on December 1, 7 to 8, 14 to 15, 21 to 22 and 28 to 29; and at Robinsons Novaliches on December 22 to 23.

Come December 24 and 31, the following malls are open from 9:00am to 8:00 pm which include Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, and Robinsons Novaliches while Forum Robinsons, Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Magnolia, Robinsons Place Manila and Robinsons Otis will open from 10:00 am until 8:00 pm. Robinsons Metro East, meanwhile, will start its operations from 10:00 am to 7:00 pm.

On Christmas Day, the following malls are open until 11:00 pm including Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Magnolia and Robinsons Place Manila. For those shopping at Forum Robinsons, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, Robinsons Metro East and Robinsons Novaliches, shoppers can buy until 10:00 pm. Shoppers at Robinsons Otis, on the other hand, can buy their presents until 9:00 pm.

The following malls are open until 12:00 midnight to accommodate all shoppers which include Robinsons Luisita on December 23 and 30; Robinsons Place Pangasinan on December 14 to 15; Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Santiago and Robinsons Place Tuguegarao on December 21 to 23. Mall-goers at Robinsons Starmills can also shop until 12:00 midnight while gazing the beautiful Giant Lantern Festival on December 15.

On Christmas Eve as well as New Year’s Eve, the following malls are open from 10:00 am until 8:00 pm. These include Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Santiago and Robinsons Place Tuguegarao. At Robinsons Place Angeles, the mall will open from 9:00 am to 7:00 pm while Robinsons Place Ilocos will open from 8:00 am to 7:00 pm. Meanwhile, Robinsons Place Pangasinan and Robinsons Starmills will start its operations on December 24 and 31 from 9:00 am until 8:00 pm.

Come December 25, the following Robinsons Malls will open from 10:00 am until 10:00 pm which include Robinsons Place Ilocos, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Santiago and Robinsons Place Tuguegarao. As you get your aguinaldos, find the latest trends at Robinsons Place Pangasinan and Robinsons Starmills opening from 9:00 am to 10:00 pm. Meanwhile, shoppers at Robinsons Place Angeles can start buying new items at the department store from 9:00 pm until 9:00 pm while those who plan to go to Robinsons Luisita on Christmas Day can grab the latest finds from 8:00 am to 9:00 pm.

Complete your Christmas shopping list as you buy presents until 12:00 midnight at Robinsons Place GenTri on December 1 to 2, 8 to 9, 15 to 16, 22 to 23 and 29 to 30; Robinsons Place Imus and Robinsons Place Naga on December 23 and 30; Robinsons Place Palawan on December 7 to 8, 14 to 15 and 21 to 23.
A day before December 25, shop at Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Place GenTri and Robinsons Place Palawan from 10:00 am to 8:00 pm; Robinsons Cainta from 9:00 am to 9:00 pm; Robinsons Place Dasmariñas from 10:00 am to 7:00 pm; Robinsons Place Imus and Robinsons Place Lipa from 10:00 am to 9:00 pm; Robinsons Place Naga from 9:00 am to 8:00 pm; and Robinsons Tagaytay from 8:00 am to 8:00 pm.

For those planning to shop at Robinsons Sta. Rosa and Robinsons Town Mall Los Baños, make sure to bring your eco bags as you buy from your favorite stores from 10:00 am to 9:00 pm starting on December 1 to 31.

For the coming New Year 2019, the following Robinsons Malls will open at 12:00 nn which include Forum Robinsons, Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Magnolia, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Metro East, Robinsons Novaliches, Robinsons Otis, Robinsons Place Angeles, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Pangasinan, Robinsons Place Santiago, Robinsosn Starmills, Robinsons Place Tuguegarao, Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Cainta, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Robinsons Place GenTri, Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Town Mall Los Baños, Robinsons Place Naga, Robinsons Place Palawan and Robinsons Sta. Rosa.
At Robinsons Tagaytay, operations start at 11:00 am while Robinsons Place Ilocos will open at 10:00 am. Finally, welcome 2019 at Robinsons Luisita as they open at 8:00 am.

To view the complete schedule of each Robinsons Malls this December and for the coming holidays, just visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or like RobinsonsMalls on Facebook; follow @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram; and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter.
